subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should `maxToolCallingRounds` ship as a built-in-OpenClaw-only public setting that fails closed whenever a plugin harness is selected?
rationale: The choice defines a permanent user configuration and harness compatibility contract; code review can validate its implementation but cannot decide whether failing configured plugin-harness runs is the intended product policy.

options.title: Accept the narrowed contract
options.body: Ship the single opt-in setting with documented built-in-only enforcement after the package-boundary, test-size, and exact-head proof gates are resolved.

options.title: Add a generic harness capability
options.body: Pause landing until agent harnesses have an explicit round-limit capability so supporting harnesses can enforce the setting without a built-in-only restriction.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9912 open and close or pause this branch until the permanent runtime and configuration policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrowed contract
recommendation.body: Ship the single opt-in setting with documented built-in-only enforcement after the package-boundary, test-size, and exact-head proof gates are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current maintainer follow-up and made the latest explicit narrowing of the configuration and harness behavior.
